#
# Regenerate ISO-derived data artifacts (if missing/stale):
# - Script timeline events (data/scripts/{fox,falco}.bin):
#     uv run python -m tools.extraction.extract_fighter_script_timeline --moves data/moves/fox.json --character fox --iso_dir _iso --melee_decomp refs/melee --special_msids_dir data/special_msids --out data/scripts/fox.bin --manifest data/scripts/fox_manifest.json
#     uv run python -m tools.extraction.extract_fighter_script_timeline --moves data/moves/falco.json --character falco --iso_dir _iso --melee_decomp refs/melee --special_msids_dir data/special_msids --out data/scripts/falco.bin --manifest data/scripts/falco_manifest.json

# - Capture current:
#     make rollout-capture ROLLOUT_JSON=reports/triage/current_rollout_streaks.json
# - Summarize current:
#     make rollout-summary ROLLOUT_JSON=reports/triage/current_rollout_streaks.json
# - Diff baseline vs current:
#     make rollout-diff ROLLOUT_BEFORE=reports/triage/rollout_streaks.json ROLLOUT_AFTER=reports/triage/current_rollout_streaks.json

# Reviewed rollout exception overlay:
# - replays/validation_exceptions.json can mark exact, reviewed first-break rows as accepted
#   package-boundary residuals. Raw rollout metrics above remain canonical; exception
#   fields are display-only review aids and fail stale if the observed seed/out/ref shape moves.
# - rollout.float_top_errors rows have matching discrete state and are the main float
#   polish targets. rollout.float_top_downstream rows already sit on a discrete mismatch path.
#   Float summaries are triage-only and do not alter validation scoring.

validation.profile.ignored: state_flags[4]&0x80 reason=Slippi fp+0x221F camera-subject / magnifying-glass visibility bit. The current RL1 target consumes gameplay state, collision, damage, hitlag, shield, item, source, identity lanes, and the other fp+0x221F gameplay-adjacent bits, but not camera-box rendering visibility. exception=Only bit 0x80 of the raw compare byte is ignored for validation totals/rollout first-break ranking. Other state_flags[4] bits, including x221F_b1/x221F_b3, remain scored.
